CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_polybase_source
WITH
(
    TYPE = HADOOP,
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@azureadlsgen2storage.dfs.core.windows.net',
    CREDENTIAL = mikecredential
);

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT raw_polybase_parquet
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
);


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.revenue_polybase
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(50),
    Revenue VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'extrnl_table/',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_polybase_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = raw_polybase_parquet
);

SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.revenue_polybase;



CREATE TABLE dbo.revenue_polybase_internal
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT *
FROM dbo.revenue_polybase;

select * from revenue_polybase_internal;
